outcome: Change in intragroup CRP levels over time
cohort: The study included infants with a positive bacterial culture during the first 72 hours of life, identified retrospectively from 2003-2012.
finding: CRP responses to bacterial sepsis during the first 72 hours of life in infants born at <= 32 weeks' gestational age are comparable to infants born at > 32 weeks' gestational age.
gest_age: Infants born at <= 32 weeks' gestational age and infants born at > 32 weeks' gestational age
